QuestInfo.name: Empressy Charm
QuestInfo.0: Cygnus's charm? She seems charming enough...\r\nTalk to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: How can we refine her elegance as an Empress? Kimu seems to be in the know.\r\n#b(Talk to Kimu.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Kimu says a dress is a must to refining one's elegance.

0.0: It's already summer. This season's goal is to improve Cygnus's charm.\r\n#L0##bReally? I hear women in love become more beautiful.#l\n#k
0.1: ...Duly noted. Anyway, I'm speaking to the #eelegance of the Empress#n. How she carries herself. Something you seem...inexperienced with. \r\n#L0##bWhatever. How do we help?#l\n#k
0.2: Ask Kimu for details. He'll tell you what we need.

yes.0: Good luck.\r\n#b(Talk to Kimu to find out what you need.)#k

no.0: I thought you wanted to help. You promised us a year.

1.0: Ah, right here. I was waiting for you.

yes.0: Charm for an Empress? Hm, I think that Cygnus needs some #bclothes with class#k. Her dress is beautiful as is, but it's simply too plain.
